text: Coolant is at 124 °C, above the 110 °C threshold for P0217, and the reading was captured after the fault was set. This is real overheating, so the van has to come off the road now.

toolInput.action: Remove from service now and do not drive. Tow to the depot and inspect the cooling system (coolant level, pump, fan, thermostat) before it returns.
